theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: China Import Logistics Fell 0.6% in January-October, Xinhua Says
top_news.summary: China’s import logistics demand contracted further in the first 10 months of the year, extending a slowdown from 9.6% growth in January-February, Xinhua News Agency reported, citing figures from the China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing.

top_news.title: Jailed Brazil Beach Soccer Star Drawn Into Russia-US Spy Dispute
top_news.summary: A Brazilian beach soccer star has become an unlikely bargaining chip in a dispute over an alleged Russian spy who has been sought by both Moscow and Washington.

top_news.title: Managing $300B for Ultra Wealthy Families: Masters in Business with Holly MacDonald
top_news.summary: Barry speaks with Holly MacDonald, CEO of Bessemer Trust. They discuss her time working in Brazil and how investing in emerging markets shapes her investment philosophy. They also discuss the enduring strength of the US dollar, and how Bessemer evolved from a single family office to a $300 billion enterprise. They also discuss how they navigate building generational wealth and moderating family conflicts.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Emerging-Market Stocks Snag Best Week Since June on Tech Rebound
top_news.summary: Emerging-market stocks posted their biggest weekly gain since June as investors piled back into technology shares following a recent selloff, capping a volatile week across global markets.

top_news.title: Hungary Credit Outlook Lifted by S&P on Budget and Euro Ambition
top_news.summary: S&P Global Ratings lifted the outlook on Hungary’s sovereign debt to stable from negative, citing planned steps by Prime Minister Peter Magyar’s cabinet to cut the budget deficit and eventually adopt the euro.

top_news.title: Brazil’s Real Caps Best Week Since 2020 as Trabuco Lifts Mood
top_news.summary: Brazilian markets rallied after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva picked one of the nation’s most prominent bankers to be his finance minister, easing the worries about his economic policies that triggered a deep selloff after his surprise re-election last month.

top_news.title: S&P 500 Has Best Week Since April 2025 on AI Rally: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Wall Street wrapped up a chaotic week with stocks climbing as a rebound in the artificial-intelligence trade gathered pace, reducing demand for Treasuries and haven currencies.

top_news.title: China Spurs Biggest Stock Gain Since 2024 on Rare Midday Vow
top_news.summary: Chinese authorities gave markets a boost with a rare midday statement pledging support, sending stocks to their best day in more than two years.

top_news.title: How Saks Is Reclaiming Luxury as Exemplar Luxury Group
top_news.summary: Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick reports on how Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly known as Saks Global, is reinventing itself for a fresh start in luxury since emerging from bankruptcy earlier this year. Exemplar Luxury Group CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck, FIT Associate Professor Shawn Grain Carter, Telsey Advisory Group CEO Dana Telsey, and Exemplary Luxury Group President and CCO Darcy Penick share their thoughts. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: ‘Dollar Storm:’ Greenback on Track for Longest Winning Run Since 2024
top_news.summary: The dollar climbed toward its longest monthly winning streak in two years as a rupture in the artificial intelligence trade and rising interest rates spur demand for safe-haven assets.
